name: windsor-essex (border wait time PWA)
what_it_holds: border-wait-times.html widget showing live Gordie Howe Bridge / Ambassador Bridge & Tunnel (Windsor-Detroit) wait times, lane status and toll calculator, alongside separate committed JSON scrapes (windsor-events.json, windsor-traffic.json, windsor-news.json, windsor-311.json); source API for the border wait feed not documented; MIT license; 5 commits, updated Aug 2026
why_useful: Marginal but real: a live front-end consuming a US-Canada bridge crossing wait-time feed at one of the busiest commercial crossings; more useful as a pointer to whatever wait-time API it consumes than as a stored dataset (that source isn't disclosed in the README).
time_coverage: live only, no historical archive apparent
size_hint: small JSON scrape files, sizes unknown
themes: Cross-border and visa data: Schengen visa statistics, ESTA, ETIAS, CBP wait times, passport index, border crossings BTS
why_all: Marginal but real: a live front-end consuming a US-Canada bridge crossing wait-time feed at one of the busiest commercial crossings; more useful as a pointer to whatever wait-time API it consumes than as a stored dataset (that source isn't disclosed in the README).

name: ha-gasbuddy
what_it_holds: Home Assistant integration (65 stars, updated 11 Sep 2026, MIT) wrapping py-gasbuddy to poll a single station's price on a schedule and expose it as a smart-home sensor.
why_useful: Same underlying GasBuddy data as py-gasbuddy but wired for scheduled polling/logging, which is closer to a ready-made point-in-time capture harness (poll daily, log to CSV) than the bare library is; still single-station granularity, needs adaptation for national/regional averages.
themes: Road travel and fuel: gas prices (EIA, AAA), vehicle miles travelled, holiday driving, toll data
why_all: Same underlying GasBuddy data as py-gasbuddy but wired for scheduled polling/logging, which is closer to a ready-made point-in-time capture harness (poll daily, log to CSV) than the bare library is; still single-station granularity, needs adaptation for national/regional averages.

name: aaa_gas_scraper
what_it_holds: Small scraper (updated 13 Sep 2026, actively run 'once a day') pulling AAA's published gas-price pages for Nevada, Las Vegas, and Reno specifically. Repo appears to be actively logging daily runs (very recent update).
why_useful: AAA's daily national/state/city average gas price feed (the standard press benchmark cited around holiday-driving forecasts) is not otherwise in our catalogue; this shows AAA's page is scrape-able and gives a working pattern, though scope is limited to 3 Nevada geographies. A generalized version (all 50 states) would be more useful than this one.
time_coverage: ongoing daily since unknown start, small n likely
size_hint: small scraper + presumably a growing local log (not confirmed committed)
themes: Road travel and fuel: gas prices (EIA, AAA), vehicle miles travelled, holiday driving, toll data
why_all: AAA's daily national/state/city average gas price feed (the standard press benchmark cited around holiday-driving forecasts) is not otherwise in our catalogue; this shows AAA's page is scrape-able and gives a working pattern, though scope is limited to 3 Nevada geographies. name: Time-Series-VMT-Analysis
what_it_holds: Committed monthly US national Vehicle Miles Traveled series 1972-2008 (likely sourced from FHWA), used for a time-series class analysis notebook/report.
why_useful: Long back-history (36 years) of national VMT could help establish seasonal/holiday-driving baselines and cyclical patterns predating the FHWA data our other candidate (trendct) covers only recently; useful mainly as a historical reference series, not current.
themes: Road travel and fuel: gas prices (EIA, AAA), vehicle miles travelled, holiday driving, toll data
why_all: Long back-history (36 years) of national VMT could help establish seasonal/holiday-driving baselines and cyclical patterns predating the FHWA data our other candidate (trendct) covers only recently; useful mainly as a historical reference series, not current.

name: COVID---19-Travel-Data
what_it_holds: Committed combined dataset: monthly TSA passenger throughput, monthly state-level VMT, quarterly average domestic airline itinerary fares by state, and monthly COVID-19 cases/deaths by state, built to compare air vs. road travel during the pandemic.
why_useful: Joins VMT with TSA throughput and airfares in one panel, which is a ready-made air-vs-road substitution frame; however TSA-post-2024 already failed as a nowcast per our own tests, and this data appears COVID-era vintage (2020-21), so its marginal value is mainly the joined structure/methodology rather than fresh numbers.
duplicate_of_holding: overlaps TSA throughput (already held) and VMT-by-state (candidate above)
themes: Road travel and fuel: gas prices (EIA, AAA), vehicle miles travelled, holiday driving, toll data
